# Data notice

The JSON files in this folder are recorded responses of a forecast API (project
building-energy-forecast). The tool results stored in `results/` quote the same
data. They contain model forecasts and aggregated meter readings derived from the
Building Data Genome Project 2:

Miller, C., Kathirgamanathan, A., Picchetti, B. et al. The Building Data Genome
Project 2, energy meter data from the ASHRAE Great Energy Predictor III
competition. Sci Data 7, 368 (2020). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-020-00712-x

That data is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0. The files here are a modified,
aggregated subset and are shared under the same licence, CC BY-SA 4.0.
The source code of this repository is under the MIT licence (see `LICENSE`).
